Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within encryption of the administrator password in the AESEncryption class. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to bypass authentication on the system. Schneider Electric has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
